All courses are held in English.
Language : English Language : The language of instruction is English.
The following tuition fees apply for applicants from: non-EU countries 1,500 EUR
Only newly enrolled international students not from EU/EEA countries have to pay tuition fees of EUR 1,500 per semester.

notes: The DAAD page states tuition for non-EU countries as 1,500 EUR; the university page and the Q&A confirm EUR 1,500 per semester. The programme-specific page and Q&A confirm the tuition applies to newly enrolled international students not from EU/EEA countries. For requirements, list of accepted English tests is inferred from quotes; the programme page also lists Cambridge, TOEIC, Oxford Test of English, and alternatives, but quotes are limited to what is included. Deadlines: the Q&A states application period usually starts mid-May and ends July 15th, but no year is given, so intake dates are not included as facts. The programme is admission-free (open admission) with direct enrolment, but international applicants must first have their certificate recognised by Studienkolleg Konstanz or uni-assist; this is captured as a manual_check and as evidence for applicationChannel. The university page states English language proficiency at B2 is required; German language proficiency is not required.

evidence.quote: Proficiency in English (at least B2) evidenced by one of the following: TOEFL- minimum scores: 550 (paper-based version) / 213 (computer-based version) / 79 (internet version)
